usage: The word '晚' refers to 'night' and is commonly used to talk about times of the day.
'晚' can be used in time expressions like '今晚' (tonight) and '晚安' (good night).
It can also indicate the latter part of the day, often after sunset.
In daily conversation, '晚' helps specify when events occur in the evening or night.
You can combine '晚' with other words to form common phrases related to night or evening.
